title: NeWS: A Networked and Extensible Window System, lecture by James Gosling
summary: A 1990 lecture by James Gosling on NeWS, Sun's networked window system in which clients send PostScript programs to the server for execution. It covers the high-level imaging model and compares NeWS with similar systems.
why: Shared in threads on window systems and X11 history as a primary-source talk on why NeWS was technically ahead of X.

quote.text: Here's James Gosling (you know, guy that invented Java) talking about it for an hour or so from 1990
